title: Real Madrid defeat Fenerbahce to lift the trophy
description: Real Madrid - Fenerbahce 85:80 Real Madrid conquered EuroLeague trophy. They fired past Fenerbahce in the championship game in Belgrade tonight. Fabien Causeur (195-SG-87) nailed 17 points to lead the champions. The teams went neck and neck throughout the first period. However Anthony Randolph wrapped the period up with a three-pointer to give Real a 21:17 lead. The Spanish team extended the lead to 8 points early in the second term. Fenerbahce however finished the half strong and ensured a 40:38 halftime advantage. Real tipped off the second half with 7 straight points to regain the lead. Fabien Causeur and Felipe Reyes (204-PF-80) gave Real a 59:52 advantage late in the period. They entered the fourth quarter up by 8 points 63:55.
